shell_commands:
git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): merge spec validated-by links into single trailing parenthetical

The spec-link parser only reads test links from a statement's LAST
trailing parenthetical; five separate ([validated by](...))} blocks meant
only the final one was indexed, leaving four tests unlinked per eslint
require-spec-link and four paths flagged by check-spec-links.

Combine all five links into one trailing parenthetical so the parser
finds all of them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git status
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1
